# 2 bed bungalow for sale

> DNG Brady are delighted to bring to the market this charming 2-Bedroom End-of-Terrace Bungalow. A wonderful opportunity to acquire a charming 2-bedroom end-of-terrace bungalow, ideally situated in a peaceful and quaint cul-de-sac in Drogheda. The property extends to 63 sq. m.
